- app/lib/features/account/account_state.dart:16-20: `listMarket` sets only `Scenario.ticker.value = symbol; Scenario.marketId.value = symbol; Scenario.hasMarket.value = true;`. Nothing records when the market was listed.

- app/lib/features/market/market_mock.dart:124-138: five seeded credits with `marketId: PortfolioMock.marketSymbol` (MAYA), dated `TradeMock.chartEnd.subtract(Duration(hours: hoursAgo))` for hoursAgo 3, 24, 48, 72 and 96. Their cents are 1240+860+1016+640+524 = 4280.
- app/lib/features/trade/trade_mock.dart:135: `chartEnd = DateTime(2026, 9, 26, 14, 45)`. scenario.dart:62 sets `clock = ValueNotifier<DateTime>(TradeMock.chartEnd)`, and nothing in lib advances the clock.
- Result: start without HAS_MARKET and list $MAYA (portfolio_screen.dart:146 leads to make_market_flow.dart:60). Every seeded credit predates the listing, yet the Wallet row (portfolio_screen.dart:245) and the Your market chip (your_market_screen.dart:190) both render `formatCents(Scenario.marketFeesCents)` = $42.80.

Fix shape follows house rule 11. One wrinkle: rule 11 says to seed the HAS_MARKET listing instant at the "fixture start" so the seeded credits still show. But scenario.dart:61 calls chartEnd itself "the fixture's start", and all five credits are 3-96 h before chartEnd. Using chartEnd literally would hide every seeded credit, which defeats the rule's stated purpose. So the seed instant becomes a fixture constant, `YourMarketMock.listedAt` = chartEnd - 7 days. That is before the oldest credit (-96 h) and matches the chip label "earned in fees this week".

No new listener is needed. In every UI path, `listMarket` also changes `marketId` (null to symbol), and the three ListenableBuilders already merge `Scenario.marketId`. Re-listing the same symbol, the only case where `marketId` would not change, has no UI path: the Make a market button only shows in place of the fees row (portfolio_screen.dart:136-146).

scenario_test.dart:26 requires every new Scenario field to be added to `state()`. `mutateEverything` already calls `AccountState.listMarket('ZED')`, which moves `listedAt` from either seed (null, or a week ago) to chartEnd. The 'field unchanged' check therefore holds without further edits.
